text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq to resume oil sales on Wednesday.
- The United States rejects an Iraqi contract under the oil-for-food deal with the U.N. to buy 100 ambulances.
- An Iraqi professor murdered in Libya.
- Deputy prime minister of Turkey says his country plans to increase cross-border trade with Iraq.
- Two vessels laden with food bought under the oil pact dock at Iraqi Umm Qasr port.
- Former British premier Thatcher accepted $8.5 million in bribes from Kuwaiti rulers in order to launch the 1991 Gulf War against Iraq.
- Japanese firms conclude a medical exhibition in Baghdad.
